Jharkhand Foundation Day: 26 salon men kitni badli jharkhand ki tasvir? prabhakar tirki se sunie
Jharkhand rajy ke gathan ko 26 sal pure ho chuke hain. in 26 varshon men rajy ki tasvir kitni badli? vikas ke morche par jharkhand ne kitni tarakki ki aur aaj bhi kin chunautiyon se jujh raha hai? shiksha, svasthy, rojgar, sarak, bijli aur aadivasi hiton ke muddon par kya kuchh badla hai?
